versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Assignment of CpSoftwareClusterCommunica- tionResource s to CpSoftwareCluster s in the context of a SwComponent- Type In case that a CompositionSwComponentType is defined and is assigned to the CpSoftwareCluster with the CpSoftwareCluster . swComposition and this SwComponentType defines an interface of the CpSoftwareCluster then the PortElementToCommunicationResourceMapping that is aggregated by a CpSoftwareClusterMappingSet maps the CpSoftwareClusterCommunica- tionResource to an element of a PortInterface used in the context of a Port- Prototype of a CompositionSwComponentType . If the PortPrototype of the CompositionSwComponentType is a PPortProto- type then the CpSoftwareClusterCommunicationResource is provided by the CpSoftwareCluster . If the PortPrototype of the CompositionSwComponentType is a RPortProto- type then the CpSoftwareClusterCommunicationResource is required by the CpSoftwareCluster .
